- Added TASK_DOCUMENTED_LIVE_FIELD_DRIFTS to official schema verification so the pinned-XSD/live-feed drift is explicit and verification still passes.

- Ran CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0 cargo test -p opentk-sync --test official_schema_sources: passed.
- Next: run captured full-sync verification if practical, then make check/test/lint, update task, switch, commit, push.

- Manual fresh full-sync verification progressed past UnknownField and exposed MissingRelationRef for Toezegging.toegezegdAan.
- Added Red 2 parser test for empty <toegezegdAan/> and confirmed it failed with MissingRelationRef.
- Greened Red 2 by treating empty nullable relation elements as absent in parse_empty_child while preserving strict errors for non-nullable/malformed relations.
- Re-ran both focused Toezegging parser tests with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0: both passed.
- Also updated generated SQL migration with toezegging__toegezegd_aan relation table and indexes; postgres_schema migration contract test passes.

- Added Red 3 for expanded empty <toegezegdAan></toegezegdAan>; confirmed it failed with MissingRelationRef.
- Greened Red 3 by applying the nullable-absent relation rule in parse_child as well as parse_empty_child.
- Reset a fresh migrated verification DB and reran timeout 180s full sync with CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0; command timed out with no emitted parse error.
- Fresh verification DB had zero ingest_error rows after timeout; this confirms the Toezegging parser failure no longer reproduces within the captured verification window.
- cargo fmt initially reported formatting drift in payload.rs; ran cargo fmt --all.
- Next: run make check, make test, make lint; then mark task passing, task_switch, commit, push.

- Final boundary refactor centralized nullable missing relation handling in parse_relation_or_absent; focused Toezegging parser tests stayed green.
- Final required gates after refactor: make check passed, make test passed, make lint passed.
- Marked bug task status done, passes true, and checked acceptance/final plan items.
- Next: run .ralph/task_switch.sh, then git add all files, commit with required message, and git push.
